blocks.html: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub's basement.
blocks.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub's basement.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

blocks.html: South of the Burgh de Rott bank, enter the cave entrance.
blocks.text: South of the Burgh de Rott bank, enter the cave entrance.

blocks.html: Read both pages of the decaying tome on the floor in the south-east corner of the room.
blocks.text: Read both pages of the decaying tome on the floor in the south-east corner of the room.

blocks.html: Take the letter on the floor south-west of the rope.
blocks.text: Take the letter on the floor south-west of the rope.

blocks.html: Search the coffin for a mysterious medallion (deals small amount of damage).
blocks.text: Search the coffin for a mysterious medallion (deals small amount of damage).

blocks.html: Climb the rope to leave the cave and then return to Veliaf Hurtz.
blocks.text: Climb the rope to leave the cave and then return to Veliaf Hurtz.

blocks.html: Once teleported, head to the northernmost room. The medallion can also teleport you to the Meiyerditch laboratory.
blocks.text: Once teleported, head to the northernmost room. The medallion can also teleport you to the Meiyerditch laboratory.

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan.

options.text: What do you think of this medallion?
What have the vampyres been doing?
I've got a letter for you.
What do you think we should do?

blocks.html: Exit the base, go through the wall to the north and climb up the stairs.
blocks.text: Exit the base, go through the wall to the north and climb up the stairs.

blocks.html: Jump the floorboards to the west and go down the ladder.
blocks.text: Jump the floorboards to the west and go down the ladder.

blocks.html: Open the door, then go west a bit, then south to the building with the fireplace.
blocks.text: Open the door, then go west a bit, then south to the building with the fireplace.

blocks.html: Enter the building and climb up the ladder, where you will briefly be held up by two vyrewatch.
blocks.text: Enter the building and climb up the ladder, where you will briefly be held up by two vyrewatch.

blocks.html: Now jump over the wall to the building to the west and climb down the ladder.
blocks.text: Now jump over the wall to the building to the west and climb down the ladder.

blocks.html: Open the door, exit and close the door.
blocks.text: Open the door, exit and close the door.

blocks.html: Now go north and west around the next building. Enter it and go east, where Vertida will be standing and talk to him.
blocks.text: Now go north and west around the next building. Enter it and go east, where Vertida will be standing and talk to him.

blocks.html: Climb the wall and speak to Mekritus A'hara.
blocks.text: Climb the wall and speak to Mekritus A'hara.

blocks.html: Stand on the lookout point for a cutscene.
blocks.text: Stand on the lookout point for a cutscene.

blocks.html: Drop-down the floorboards to the east.
blocks.text: Drop-down the floorboards to the east.

blocks.html: Talk to Nessie who is in the courtyard south of the building.
blocks.text: Talk to Nessie who is in the courtyard south of the building.

options.text: How do you know my name?

blocks.html: Attack Vanescula Drakan - she will knock you back (if she does not knock you back, dismiss any active conjured spirits, unequip any armour, and climb up and back down the wall to the east, then try talking to her again).
blocks.text: Attack Vanescula Drakan - she will knock you back (if she does not knock you back, dismiss any active conjured spirits, unequip any armour, and climb up and back down the wall to the east, then try talking to her again).

blocks.html: Talk to her and exhaust all options, eventually learning about the tree and receiving an envelope.
blocks.text: Talk to her and exhaust all options, eventually learning about the tree and receiving an envelope.

options.text: I'm not telling you anything, vampyre scum!
How do you plan on freeing Meiyerditch?
You won't get any information out of me.
Why do you want to kill Drakan?
Tell me more about this tree.
How do I know you are telling the truth?

blocks.html: Teleport to Meiyerditch with the medallion and take the envelope to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Teleport to Meiyerditch with the medallion and take the envelope to Safalaan.

blocks.html: In the same room, talk to Vertida Sefalatis.
blocks.text: In the same room, talk to Vertida Sefalatis.

options.text: What do I need to go to Darkmeyer?

blocks.html: Head to the most south-western point within the Meiyerditch hideout. Search the crate for 30 smoke bombs.
blocks.text: Head to the most south-western point within the Meiyerditch hideout. Search the crate for 30 smoke bombs.

blocks.html: With your medallion, teleport to the Meiyerditch laboratory.
blocks.text: With your medallion, teleport to the Meiyerditch laboratory.

blocks.html: Go up the stairs, open the door, go through the slashed tapestry, and then out of the building.
blocks.text: Go up the stairs, open the door, go through the slashed tapestry, and then out of the building.

blocks.html: Run north and squeeze-through the grate on the north wall.
blocks.text: Run north and squeeze-through the grate on the north wall.

blocks.html: Talk to Vanescula on the other side of the grate. In Darkmeyer, the vyrewatch will attack you when you pass them as opposed to in Meiyerditch.
blocks.text: Talk to Vanescula on the other side of the grate. In Darkmeyer, the vyrewatch will attack you when you pass them as opposed to in Meiyerditch.

options.text: I'll get on with it, then.

blocks.html: Use the smoke bombs to avoid being caught by vampyre juvinates. Do not go near vyrewatch.
blocks.text: Use the smoke bombs to avoid being caught by vampyre juvinates. Do not go near vyrewatch.

blocks.html: Search chests inside buildings to find clothing (four pieces in total). You can use another smoke bomb before the previous one dissipates. Enter a building before your smoke shroud vanishes. Once in a building, immediately close the door.
blocks.text: Search chests inside buildings to find clothing (four pieces in total). You can use another smoke bomb before the previous one dissipates. Enter a building before your smoke shroud vanishes. Once in a building, immediately close the door.

blocks.html: Fix all four pieces and wear them. You no longer need to hide in smoke.
blocks.text: Fix all four pieces and wear them. You no longer need to hide in smoke.

blocks.html: Return to Vanescula.
blocks.text: Return to Vanescula.

options.text: So can I go and get those logs now?

options.text: Perhaps I could help you get them back?

blocks.text: Upper tier

blocks.html: Killing Captured Meiyerditch citizens for the Vyrewatch guards is the fastest way to fill the reputation bar, as each kill gives 2 reputation but there is a limit to how many you can kill in a short period of time. There are about a dozen locked in the jail and they respawn fairly quick. Start the task by talking to a Vyrewatch guard in the south-western jail.

options.text: But the vampyres will be furious! You've betrayed us!

options.text: I managed to get some logs from the blisterwood tree.

I'd be happy to dispatch one of the Myreque's most fearsome opponents.

blocks.html: Craft each of the logs into a staff, a polearm, and a set of stakes. Remember to set the quantity to 1 in the Build-X interface or you will lose the logs permanently. Fletching the blisterwood polearm leads to the achievement Raising The Stakes.

blocks.html: Enter the house with Harold in it (just north-east of the captured citizens) and kill him with any weapon. You must throw the bottle of holy water over him to be able to kill him.

blocks.html: Go back to the bank and prepare for the final fight with Vanstrom Klause who is east of Harold.

recommended.html: Combat armour and prayer potions

blocks.html: How to kill Vanstrom:
Only blisterwood weaponry can deal damage.
blocks.text: Only blisterwood weaponry can deal damage.

blocks.html: If you're attacking at a distance use Deflect/Protect from Magic; otherwise, Deflect/Protect from Melee.
blocks.text: If you're attacking at a distance use Deflect/Protect from Magic; otherwise, Deflect/Protect from Melee.

blocks.html: If he shouts "Stare into the darkness!" run to the edge of the arena and rotate your camera away from him. Maximum 4000 damage.
blocks.text: If he shouts "Stare into the darkness!" run to the edge of the arena and rotate your camera away from him. Maximum 4000 damage.

blocks.html: If he shouts "Let the blood consume you!" run away from the blood splodge on the floor. Maximum 6000 damage.
blocks.text: If he shouts "Let the blood consume you!" run away from the blood splodge on the floor. Maximum 6000 damage.

blocks.html: If he shouts "Come, fiends, and aid your master!" kill the two easy minions that he spawns.
blocks.text: If he shouts "Come, fiends, and aid your master!" kill the two easy minions that he spawns.

blocks.html: If he throws blood bombs towards you, keep running around the room to avoid them. Maximum 4000 damage per bomb.
blocks.text: If he throws blood bombs towards you, keep running around the room to avoid them. Maximum 4000 damage per bomb.

blocks.html: Once he is very low health he turns into a cloud. Keep using holy water near him until he loses all health. Unequip your ring of life if you're wearing one.
blocks.text: Once he is very low health he turns into a cloud. Keep using holy water near him until he loses all health. Unequip your ring of life if you're wearing one.

substeps.html: If you are saved by a ring of life after a group of bloodveld guardians spawn, heal up and return without a ring of life. You will be damaged, but in a safe way. You will not have to redo the fight.
substeps.text: If you are saved by a ring of life after a group of bloodveld guardians spawn, heal up and return without a ring of life. You will be damaged, but in a safe way. You will not have to redo the fight.

blocks.html: Use Deflect/Protect from Magic for this last part as Vanstom can do rapid magic damage to you whilst he is dying.
blocks.text: Use Deflect/Protect from Magic for this last part as Vanstom can do rapid magic damage to you whilst he is dying.

blocks.html: Take control of Vanescula and kill the Bloodveld guardians. It is recommended to use the Shriek attack repeatedly as soon as it recharges.
